editorNote: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a new frontier model it says is much stronger at cybersecurity. Access looks limited so far, and the leaderboard claims come from secondhand coverage. Elsewhere, PyTorch shipped 2.15, Anthropic filed an S-1, and Chrome autofill can now draw on Gmail data, which is worth a look if you manage browsers.
